proof.criterion: The nine resolutions keep both parents; shutdown drains #2391's intakes and releases the publisher hold before the pool closes
proof.surface: the PR's own diff of each runtime file against main 225f2beae, and cmd/dispatch's shutdown tests
proof.command: jj diff --from 225f2beae --to 827ab32f07 for shutdown.go, pool.go, pglisten/listener.go, docs/edit_notices.go, infra/gcp/dispatch.go, shutdown_test.go; go test -v ./cmd/dispatch/
proof.observed: shutdown.go at the head runs: HTTP drain, documents, waitBackground, waitIntakes (main's #2391), then, once waitUntilIdle reports the database answering, waitForOutbox (this PR, bounded by outboxStopBudget), deregister, pool.Close. So the intakes drain before the outbox wait, and the outbox records its batch and releases the hold before the pool closes; the PR adds only the outbox wait and its parameter. pool.go: main's four permanent listeners (with #2391's shared hub) plus the outbox's LISTEN = 5, outboxPoolSize 1 -> 2, comments to match. pglisten/listener.go and docs/edit_notices.go: comments only. infra/gcp/dispatch.go: dispatchConnectionsPerPod 90 -> 92. shutdown_test.go: main's tests unchanged but for the added nil outboxStopped argument, plus this PR's stalling-publisher test. Both sides' tests pass: TestShutdownWaitsForTheOutboxToReleaseThePublisherHold, TestShutdownWaitsForAnIntakeHandlerBeforeClosingThePool, TestShutdownWaitsForDeliveryWorkBeforeClosingThePool, TestAPanicAfterTheIntakesStartEndsTheProcess, every TestSIGTERM* (the database-unanswering one included); cmd/dispatch ok 315.8 s.
proof.negativeControl: TestSIGTERMWithTheDatabaseUnansweringExitsWithinTheShutdownBudget: with the database unanswering, shutdown skips the outbox wait and exits within budget.
